name: Le Chat (Mistral AI)
summary: European open-weight models and the Le Chat assistant.
description: Mistral AI is a French company building frontier open-weight language models and the Le Chat assistant. Its differentiator is control: models can be customized and deployed on-premise, in a private VPC or in Mistral's cloud, which appeals to European and regulated organizations. Le Chat has a free plan, with paid tiers for individuals and teams and pay-as-you-go API access.

howToUse.title: Start from the models
howToUse.description: The homepage says to start with Mistral's frontier and specialist open-weight models, and to use them as they are or make them specific to your organization.

howToUse.title: Customize with Forge
howToUse.description: The page says Forge customizes models around your data, use cases, and requirements.

howToUse.title: Build in Studio or Vibe
howToUse.description: The page says Studio is where you build, govern, and improve agents and applications, and that Vibe brings that AI into research, coding, and everyday tasks.

howToUse.title: Choose where it runs
howToUse.description: The page says you can run on-prem, in your VPC, or have Mistral host inference.
